method.processes: new Node per variant/volume/phase; query processes never ingest
method.first: first invocation per scenario after Store open; process-cold, OS cache uncontrolled and warmed by seed/previous phases
method.warm: 6 subsequent calls; same order/queries for both; no forced GC
method.memory: bytes; processPeakRss is OS high-water including imports, measured in each own process; heap sampled between operations (not a true heap peak)
method.startup: CLI help elapsed including Node startup/JSON, separate from direct Store calls; no socket/network/startup claim for daemon
method.disk: dbstat allocated pages by table/index; checkpointed DB plus WAL/SHM and writer lock while open; no VACUUM
method.fixtureEquivalence: SHA256 same seeded messages/requests, query result SHA256 equality asserted for both volumes before/after mutations
